name: Corporate Action Preliminary Advice Type 4
definition: Type of movement preliminary advice document.

MovementPreliminaryAdviceIdentification.name: Movement Preliminary Advice Identification
MovementPreliminaryAdviceIdentification.definition: Unique identification of the group of corporate action movement preliminary advice messages when the preliminary advice is split in multiple (paginated) messages.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of movement preliminary advice, for example. new or replacement.

Function.name: Function
Function.definition: Specifies whether the message advises about the final eligible balance and entitlements or about an upcoming posting or reversal of securities and/or cash postings.
